name: LMNT
positioning: LMNT was a streaming text-to-speech and voice-cloning API provider; its website now states that it has shut down.

pricing.model: None; the vendor's pricing page now shows a shutdown notice.
pricing.headline: No live pricing; the service has shut down.

limitations.claim: The vendor's own site states: 'LMNT has shut down. Our speech generation journey has come to an end.' (lmnt.com, docs.lmnt.com and the pricing page all show this notice.)

stepsToMove: LMNT's site and docs show a shutdown notice; the API (api.lmnt.com) did not complete a TLS connection from the research host, so integrations must move to another provider.
Replace the LMNT speech request and X-API-Key header with the ReadAloud speech endpoint and bearer key; voice IDs and any cloned voices do not carry over.

bestFor: Not applicable: the service has shut down.
